reason: The README describes a long-form novel writing engine centered on coordinating parallel generation, research, lore management, semantic retrieval, review, and project-file workflows, so orchestration is the best primary category.

summaries.zh: 用于协调长篇网络小说创作流程的插件，支持大纲、续写、并行草稿、设定管理、资料检索、一致性审校和本地书库维护。
summaries.en: A long-form web-novel writing plugin that coordinates outlining, drafting, parallel generation, lore management, research, consistency review, and local library workflows.

capabilities: Generates and revises long-form novel content through DeepSeek API calls
Runs parallel drafting, outlining, brainstorming, research, review, and multi-thread narrative workflows
Reads, writes, indexes, exports, and deletes local novel-project and library files
Uses configured API credentials and optionally calls a DashScope embedding endpoint
Maintains lore, outlines, chapter logs, semantic indexes, usage records, and serialisation plans
